description.en: The email address of the user.

description.zh:
新的用户密码，设置规则如下：

由大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符中的至少三种组成。

!@#$%^&*()_+-=为特殊字符。

长度为 8~32 个字符。
description.en:
The new user password. The password must meet the following rules:

The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

The supported special characters are !@#$%^&*()_+-=.

The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun clickhouse reset-langfuse-user-password --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id lfs-0000 --email john@company.com --new-password 2F9e9@000000 --api-version 2023-05-22 --region cn-hangzhou
